sources.title: Pre- and Post-Inference Hooks (Blocking) with Model Metadata
sources.snippet: Pre-inference hook - runs before any model is loaded or inference begins. LM Studio should wait for this process to finish before proceeding with inference. P ost-inference hook - runs after the model has finished generating and is unloaded (or the inference session ends).

sources.title: How do i resolve this issue in LMStudio? - Models - Hugging Face Forums
sources.snippet: This is usually resolved by treating it as a download-source resolution problem, not a model-runtime problem. In your case, LM Studio is trying to resolve the qwen/qwen3-coder-next catalog entry, and that catalog entry expands into four underlying repos: one GGUF repo and three MLX repos.
